source.name: Esports World Cup - EWC 26 Partners (stc page)
source.note: 'The leading digital enabler, powering Saudi Arabia's digital transformation, is the Esports World Cup Elite and Founding Partner for the third year in a row.' Partner tiers: Elite stc; Nexus Qiddiya; Strategic Lenovo, Sony, Allianz, Aramco, Saudia; Main Hilton, OBSBOT, ALBAIK; Supplier Secretlab, Webook, NRJ.

note: Elite Partner and Founding Partner; the relationship dates to the first 2024 edition ('third year in a row').
